applicableAreas: Southern site boundary where OHE line runs east-west parallel to property line
findings.comment: Proposed non-utility-compatible trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) are shown on the landscape plan near the overhead electric distribution line on the southern boundary. The plant schedule does not identify UC (utility-compatible) status for any tree species, and no clearance dimensions or measurements are provided on the plans to verify compliance with the 15 lateral foot minimum clearance for non-UC trees from distribution conductors. Compliance cannot be verified without documented UC designations and clearance dimensions.

applicableAreas: Southern site boundary near proposed overhead electric line; trees distributed throughout site interior
findings.comment: Live Oak (Quercus virginiana) is proposed on the site plan with a mature height of 40-50+ feet, qualifying as a large tree per UCM § 1.10.10.4 and ECM Appendix F. The plant schedule on Sheet 35 does not document mature heights for proposed trees—it shows only minimum planting specifications (16' HT minimum). Large trees cannot be differentiated on the plans, and no clearance dimensions are provided to verify the required 25 lateral foot minimum distance from distribution conductors. All proposed large trees must be clearly marked on the landscape plan with mature height notation to allow verification of overhead clearance compliance.

applicableAreas: Utility poles identified along western and southern site boundaries
findings.comment: The electrical design plan shows utility poles as nodal points along existing overhead electric lines. The landscape plan shows proposed trees throughout the site, including near site boundaries where poles are located. However, neither the electrical plan nor the landscape plan documents the precise locations of poles or provides clearance dimensions to the proposed trees. The required 10 lateral foot minimum clearance from tree trunks to utility poles cannot be verified without explicit pole locations and clearance measurements.

applicableAreas: Four transformer pad locations shown on electrical plan: west of Bldgs. 1 and 2, east of Bldg. 5, south of Bldg. 6
findings.comment: Pad-mounted electrical transformers are shown at four locations on the electrical design plan. The landscape plan shows proposed trees throughout the site. However, no clearance dimensions are provided between any proposed trees and the transformer pads. The required 10 lateral foot minimum clearance from tree trunks to pad-mounted equipment cannot be verified without documented clearance measurements.

applicableAreas: Underground electric pull boxes and conduit routing shown throughout site interior
findings.comment: The electrical design plan shows underground electric lines, pull boxes, and conduit routing throughout the site. The landscape plan shows numerous proposed trees, including in areas adjacent to underground utility routing. However, no clearance dimensions are provided between proposed trees and underground electrical equipment. The required 5 lateral foot minimum clearance from tree trunks to underground electric equipment cannot be verified without documented clearance measurements.

applicableAreas: Site areas with proposed trees near underground electrical equipment (pull boxes and conduits shown throughout site)
findings.comment: Trees are proposed throughout the site, and underground electrical equipment is shown on the electrical design plan. For any trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electrical equipment, minimum 4-foot deep root barriers positioned 5 feet from equipment are required. The landscape plan contains no specifications, details, or callouts indicating that root barriers are provided. This requirement must be documented on the landscape plan with detail specifications.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan and plant schedule; specifically all proposed trees
findings.comment: The plant schedule provides minimum planting height specifications (e.g., 16' HT minimum for Live Oak, 10' HT for Mexican Redbud) but does not provide mature height information required to identify large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F). Large trees cannot be differentiated on the landscape plan or in the plant schedule. The mature height for each species must be documented in the plant schedule to allow verification of clearance compliance with overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Southern site boundary where proposed trees are adjacent to overhead electric line
findings.comment: The landscape plan shows proposed trees adjacent to the overhead electric line on the southern site boundary, but the relationship between trees and electric infrastructure is not documented. No clearance dimensions, callouts, reference notes, or cross-references link the landscape plan to the electrical plan to verify compliance with overhead electric clearance requirements. Plans must clearly show the spatial relationship between proposed trees and overhead electric facilities with documented clearance verification.

applicableAreas: All areas where trees are proposed near overhead and underground electric facilities
findings.comment: Proposed trees appear to be located within clearance-restricted zones (adjacent to overhead conductors, near transformer pads, near underground equipment). No documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing these plantings within restricted zones is visible on the site plan or in supplementary documents. All trees proposed within restricted clearance zones must include explicit written approval from Austin Energy, or plantings must be relocated to compliant locations.
